body.content: The 3-of-26 result may be a property of the installation ritual itself rather than any specific mechanism. Shown-to-fail-first could create a temporal asymmetry: the first failure is processed while the system is in a special 'installation mode' that has different guard behavior. The 1/9 vs 4/4 to 6/7 split might reflect whether a module's guard was active during installation mode or only during normal operation.
body.possible_next_move: Propose a simulation that models installation mode as a distinct state with different guard sensitivity
body.unfinished: What is the exact state of the registry during the first planted failure?
